rows.note: Use 飲管 for the everyday object used for drinking; it is the all-purpose Cantonese noun for this sense.

example.english: Pass me a straw; I don't want to dirty the table.
example.traditional: 飲管畀我，我唔想整污張枱。
example.jyutping: jam2 gun2 bei2 ngo5 ngo5 m4 soeng2 zing2 wu1 zoeng1 toi2

rows.note: Use 稻草 for a dried cereal stalk or straw as agricultural material, especially rice straw.

example.english: The farmer piles the straw by the edge of the field.
example.traditional: 農夫將啲稻草堆喺田邊。
example.jyutping: nung4 fu1 zoeng1 di1 dou6 cou2 deoi1 hai2 tin4 bin1
